text: Before you trade in your current e-bike, consider waiting. The industry is moving at breakneck speed. With battery density climbing and production costs falling, the next generation of commuters will be significantly lighter, more efficient, and more affordable. We are also seeing mid-drive motor technology finally hitting a sweet spot in price-to-performance. Unless your current ride is failing or becoming unsafe, holding out for the next release cycle is almost always the smarter move for both your wallet and your back.
